text:
maria: FYI — OKR slate v3 is up. PTAL before the 11:00 walkthrough. Need alignment on company-level goals and launch criteria. sign-off target: EOD Fri. Link: https://drive.redwood/okrs/q2_draft_v3.md
alex: I can join 11. Two quick asks: clarify p99 target for hosted API and Dedicated capacity SLA.
sam: eng flag — rollout automation is behind. prefer splitting 'full rollout' into canary -> automated rollout. otherwise we'll miss Q2 timeline.
prateek: research note — add an eval gate for model quality (topline perf + regression threshold). I'll draft the wording.
elaine: design note — launch criteria should include 'no blocking UX flows' and completion of onboarding checklist. tiny copy tweak.
jamie: @maria finance: revenue + cost assumptions look optimistic. please add a sensitivity band (+/- 20%) and explicit hiring cost assumptions.
deploy-bot: Reminder: draft uploaded -> /drive/okrs/q2_draft_v3.md (id:1935002468)
maria: Thanks — can we capture these as action items in the doc? I'll update after the walkthrough.
sam: Proposed OKR tweak: OKR 2.1 -> 'Automated canary rollout' with milestone: 'canary stable for 2 weeks' then 'scale to fleet'. Reduces risk and makes timeline realistic.
alex: :eyes: sounds reasonable. Also add a fallback policy: automatic downgrade to smaller model variant if latency SLO breach.
prateek: I'll add eval gate snippet: ```eval_gate: metric=win_rate; delta_threshold=1.5%``` — will push a PR to the doc.
elaine: UX checklist snippet incoming tonight; will include copy and success criteria.
jamie: Finance: approve in principle conditional on updated sensitivity + realistic hiring costs added.
maria: Action list (I'll track in the doc): 1) add eval gate (prateek) 2) split rollout (sam) 3) UX checklist (elaine) 4) sensitivity scenarios (jamie) 5) tighten SLA wording (alex). Who can sign after updates?
alex: I can sign off on product+eng portions once updated.
prateek: research sign-off ✅ after eval gate wording is in.
elaine: :thumbsup: design sign-off.
jamie: I'll confirm budget Monday morning.
maria: OK — target: final doc by Monday 10:00 for formal sign-off. Thanks all.
